edits.new:
Then the stored file of "IN-0011" is unchanged and only document_field rows are written

  Scenario: AC16 A caller without a valid token or without Documents R is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    When a caller without a valid token calls GET /api/recovery/document/v1/documents/DOC-0010
    Then the response is 401 and no field value is returned
    When a caller with a valid token and without Documents R calls GET /api/recovery/document/v1/documents/DOC-0010
    Then the response is 403 and no field value is returned

  Scenario: AC17 A retried extraction attempt that times out is not written partially (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the extractor does not answer within 60 seconds on attempt 1 for item "IN-0012" and answers on attempt 2
    When extractStep runs
    Then the activity retries and extracted_fields of "IN-0012" holds one set of fields

  Scenario: AC18 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given item "IN-0001" has extract_status "DONE"
    When an attempt sets extract_status of "IN-0001" to "PENDING"
    Then the change is refused and extract_status stays "DONE"
